name: The Hidden Key
summary: Bookie Herod's papers lead you to a strongbox in the Stockpile. Its contents may reveal how Private Thorsen's cover was blown.

sections.title: A Secret in the Bindings
sections.body: Bookie Herod's ledgers never name Private Thorsen. But one book hides a small brass key in its binding. Scraps among the papers point to a strongbox in the Stockpile, the cavern complex behind Kurzen's Compound. Inside may lie the reason Thorsen's cover was blown.

sections.title: Deep into the Stockpile
sections.body: Deep in the cave system behind Kurzen's Compound, the strongbox waits among stacked crates. The sturdy chest is heavy and bound in bronze.

faq.q: Where did this brass key come from?
aliases: how did i get the key
faq.answer: The small brass key was hidden in the binding of one of Bookie Herod's ledger books, found among his paperwork.

faq.q: Where is Bookie Herod's strongbox located?
faq.answer: Bookie Herod's strongbox sits in the Stockpile, the cave complex at the rear of Kurzen's Compound.
Bookie Herod's loose papers do not explain how Private Thorsen's presence was compromised. They point to a secure strongbox that may hold the answer.
This follows the search through Bookie Herod's ledger records during the investigation of him.
